section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Overdrive Input Shaft and Clutch)
title: Overdrive Input Shaft and Clutch

content.description: Exploded view diagram showing the complete assembly of the overdrive input shaft and clutch components in two main sections - upper section shows OD clutch drum assembly with multiple clutch plates and springs, lower section shows outer race assembly with thrust bearings and planetary gear

content.text: DISASSEMBLY OF OVERDRIVE INPUT SHAFT AND CLUTCH

content.description: Illustration showing hands sliding off thrust bearing and race from clutch side

items.title: REMOVE THRUST BEARINGS AND RACES FROM OVERDRIVE INPUT SHAFT

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Slide off the thrust bearing and race from the clutch side by hand. Note the position of the races.

substeps.label: (b)
substeps.text: Using a screwdriver, pry off the thrust washer from the planetary gear side.

content.description: Illustration showing hands pulling overdrive clutch assembly from input shaft

items.title: PULL OVERDRIVE CLUTCH ASSEMBLY FROM INPUT SHAFT

content.text: Be careful that the thrust bearing and race do not fall out.

substeps.text: Note the position of the race.
